solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sobbing Tory leader in weak state

parts.note: something weak is lame, as a lame excuse

indicators.note: in says the leading letter is set inside the two words that follow it

parts.note: a state is a nation

indicators.note: leader asks for only the opening letter of the word Tory

explanation.surface: A Conservative chief, weeping in a feeble country.
explanation.definitionFit: Sobbing is weeping aloud in grief, which is what a lament or wailing expresses.

clue.text: Supporter after drink outside

indicators.note: outside says the drink wraps round the word for after

parts.note: ale is a drink, a type of beer
post- means after, as in postwar

explanation.surface: A fan follows a drink taken outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supporter' suggests a fan or prop, but here it is a follower of Christ or of a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: An apostle is a devoted follower and advocate of a cause or leader.

clue.text: Practised cut outside emergency room

indicators.note: outside says the word for cut sits around the hospital abbreviation

parts.note: excised means cut out, as surgeons remove tissue

explanation.surface: Someone rehearsed surgery just beyond the casualty ward.
explanation.definitionFit: To have exercised a skill or right is to have practised or used it.

clue.text: Question Time with head of state about jobs

indicators.note: about says the two letters go round the verb of questioning
head of asks for just the first letter of state

parts.note: to question someone is to ask

explanation.surface: A TV debate programme with a national leader discusses employment.
explanation.walkthrough: Question Time is a BBC political debate show, but here the words split. 'head of' gives S, and 'about' puts T and S round ASK.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasks are pieces of work to be done, which is what jobs are.

clue.text: Labour scent seizing a victory

indicators.note: seizing says the scent word grabs and holds the next pieces inside

parts.note: a trail is the scent left for hounds to follow
V stands for victory, as in the V sign

explanation.surface: A political party's track record includes winning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' looks like the British political party; it is the definition, meaning hard work. 'seizing' puts A + V inside TRAIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Travail is painful or laborious effort, a synonym of toil or labour.

clue.text: Very big tenor followed by ample bird

parts.note: OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize, meaning very big
T is the abbreviation for tenor in music
rich can mean plentiful or ample, as in a rich supply

explanation.surface: A huge singer is followed by a generously built bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The ostrich is a large flightless African bird, the biggest living species.

clue.text: Youth caught in a benefit environment

parts.note: the dole is British slang for unemployment benefit

indicators.note: in places the letter for caught inside the run of words after it

parts.note: a scene is a setting or environment
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A young person is trapped in a world of welfare payments.
explanation.walkthrough: The dole is British slang for state unemployment benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: Adolescence is the period of growing up between childhood and adulthood, one's youth.

clue.text: Wash flapping on pegs

indicators.note: flapping, like laundry in the wind, signals the letters move about

explanation.surface: Laundry blows about on the clothes line.
explanation.definitionFit: To sponge something is to clean it by wiping with a wet cloth or sponge.

clue.text: Feel grief for dead and record traditions

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for dead, as on family trees
an EP is an extended-play record
lore is the body of traditional knowledge and beliefs

explanation.surface: Mourning the deceased and writing down old customs.
explanation.definitionFit: To deplore something is to lament it or feel deep regret about it.

clue.text: Worker housed in modest shack

indicators.note: housed in says the labourer is lodged inside the word for modest

parts.note: shy means modest or retiring
an ant is the classic crossword worker, from worker ants

explanation.surface: A labourer lives in a humble hut.
explanation.walkthrough: Ants are the stock crossword worker, from worker ants in a colony.
explanation.definitionFit: A shanty is a crude, roughly built hut or cabin, much like a shack.

clue.text: During the game, she's no reserve!

definitions.text: During the game, she's no reserve!

parts.words: During the game, she's no reserve!
parts.note: reads like a team player who always starts, but describes someone on the sidelines who leads the crowd's noisy support and shows no restraint

explanation.surface: During the match she is never on the substitutes' bench.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reserve' means both a substitute player and restraint; this performer is famously unrestrained.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who leads organised chanting for a sports team clearly shows no reserve or shyness.

clue.text: In a cult, turning psychotic

indicators.note: turning signals the letters of the phrase are spun into a new order

explanation.surface: Within a sect, someone is going mad.
explanation.definitionFit: A lunatic, in informal use, is a mad or psychotic person.

clue.text: Prodigal son before getting servile

parts.note: prodigal means extravagant or lavish

explanation.surface: The prodigal son, before returning, becomes humble.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface evokes the parable of the prodigal son, but 'Prodigal' gives LAVISH and 'son' gives S.
explanation.definitionFit: Slavish means servile, showing excessive submission like a slave.

clue.text: Sunday setter's hiding last of clue riddle

indicators.note: hiding says the setter's phrase conceals the next letter inside

parts.note: the setter is me, so setter's reads as I've, setter has

indicators.note: last of asks for the final letter of clue

explanation.surface: A weekend crossword compiler conceals the end of a puzzle clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last of' gives E, which 'hiding' puts inside IVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To riddle is to sift through a coarse mesh, the job a sieve does.

clue.text: Where you may find dead end?

definitions.text: Where you may find dead end?

parts.words: Where you may find dead end?
parts.note: a dead end sounds like a blind alley, but it is where a dead person ends up: a tomb

explanation.surface: Where might one hit a cul-de-sac?
explanation.definitionFit: A sepulchre is a tomb or burial chamber, the final resting place of the dead.

clue.text: China core thrown with undecorated exterior

indicators.note: exterior says the word for undecorated forms the outer layer round the rest

parts.note: plain means undecorated or unadorned

indicators.note: thrown, as a pot on a wheel, signals the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A pottery centre is shaped on the wheel with a simple glaze outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown' is the potter's word for shaping clay on a wheel, apt for china, and here signals rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: China is the everyday name for fine ceramic ware, especially porcelain.

clue.text: Elaborate couturier returns in glowing form

indicators.note: in places the turned designer's name inside the glowing coal

parts.note: an ember is a glowing piece of coal or wood

indicators.note: returns says the designer's name is read backwards

parts.note: Dior is a famous French couturier

explanation.surface: A fashion designer comes back in radiant shape.
explanation.walkthrough: Christian Dior was the French fashion designer behind the house of Dior.
explanation.definitionFit: To embroider a story is to elaborate on it, adding fanciful details.

clue.text: He shows off hat around Sabbath

indicators.note: around says the hat goes round the single letter

parts.note: a boater is a flat-topped straw hat

explanation.surface: A man flaunts his straw hat on the day of rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A boaster is a braggart, someone who shows off about himself.

clue.text: Prepared to do porridge?

parts.note: reads like a convict ready to serve time, since doing porridge is British slang for a prison term, but describes ground oats made ready for breakfast

explanation.surface: Is a criminal ready to serve a prison sentence?
explanation.walkthrough: 'doing porridge' is British slang for serving time in jail; here porridge is the breakfast dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground oats are cooked to make porridge, so the grain is what gets prepared for it.

clue.text: Constituent of ropes is a long fibre

indicators.note: Constituent of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A part of ropes is an extended strand.
explanation.definitionFit: Sisal is a stiff plant fibre from an agave, used to make rope and twine.

clue.text: Tighter second row, leaders of English rugby

parts.note: a row is a quarrel, a tiff

indicators.note: leaders of asks for the opening letter of each of the two words

explanation.surface: The second row forwards lead the English rugby pack more tightly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' is not the rugby scrum line but an argument, rhyming with cow.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiffer means more rigid or taut, so tighter in the sense of less give.

clue.text: Ends of short dress giving quick flash

indicators.note: Ends of asks for the first and last letters of short

parts.note: a robe is a long loose garment, a dress

explanation.surface: The hems of a brief frock give a sudden glimpse.
explanation.definitionFit: A strobe is a lamp that gives rapid bright flashes of light.

clue.text: Engage pop star with hidden talent

indicators.note: with hidden says the singer has the skill concealed inside her

parts.note: Cher is a famous American pop singer
art is skill or talent, as in the art of persuasion

explanation.surface: Hire a pop singer who has secret abilities.
explanation.walkthrough: Cher is the American singer known by one name; 'Engage' here means hire, not betroth.
explanation.definitionFit: To charter a boat or plane is to hire or engage it for one's use.

clue.text: Very masculine domain

parts.note: real is used informally for very, as in real good
M is the abbreviation for masculine in grammar

explanation.surface: A thoroughly macho territory.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a kingdom or field of activity, the same as a domain.

clue.text: Hunger, it really grips country

indicators.note: grips says the words hold the country's name within them

explanation.surface: Famine truly has a nation in its grasp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grips' points to the run of letters inside 'Hunger, it really'.
explanation.definitionFit: Eritrea is a country in the Horn of Africa, on the Red Sea.

clue.text: Fabulous woman afterwards consumed by case of anorexia

indicators.note: consumed by says the time word is swallowed inside the outer letters
case of asks for the outer letters of anorexia, its casing

parts.note: then means afterwards, next

explanation.surface: A stunning lady is later struck by an eating disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fabulous' means from fable, so a mythical woman rather than a marvellous one.
explanation.definitionFit: Athena is the Greek goddess of wisdom, a female figure of myth and fable.

clue.text: Ace female, fine, fit and obliging

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for ace in cards
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
able means fit or capable

explanation.surface: A top-class, healthy, attractive woman is helpful.
explanation.definitionFit: Affable means friendly and good-natured, readily pleasant and accommodating.

clue.text: Army in peril regrouped for advance

indicators.note: regrouped, like troops reforming, signals the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: Soldiers in danger reorganise before pushing forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'advance' looks like a verb of marching, but is an adjective, as in advance notice. 'regrouped' rearranges ARMYINPERIL.
explanation.definitionFit: An advance warning is a preliminary one, coming before the main event.
